summary: Full E2E validation of LOGILINK GLOBAL Phase 1 (backend + frontend). Backend: 25/25 pytest tests PASSED covering AUTH login (admin/admin123, operateur/op123), 401 on protected endpoints without token, 200 with admin, PUBLIC POST /api/parcels & GET /api/parcels/{id} & GET .../pdf, RBAC (operator forbidden from /api/users and /api/audit -> 403; operator allowed on /api/parcels & /api/stats), rich /api/stats shape (14-day daily_activity, 17-key status_counts, direction_counts, revenue_collected/pending, weight/volume, clients/senders/receivers, success_rate, avg_delivery_days, monthly_activity), parcel lifecycle history append on PATCH /status and PATCH body, no-op re-status doesn't duplicate history, admin can create user & operator cannot. Frontend: Home tracking input, language toggle FR default, Send form for BOTH directions with FIXED Italy hub (Simo Patrice / Via Roma 35 / 26866 / Lodi / +39 3287091255) VERIFIED INTACT, submit creates parcel & shows success + download-ticket link pointing to /api/parcels/{id}/pdf, Tracking valid ID renders result, invalid shows error. Login admin/admin123 -> /backoffice OK; 12 KPI cards (kpi-0..kpi-11) render; 3 recharts present; Parcels view lists 29 rows, parcels-search filters instantly, detail drawer opens with status-select + update-status-btn, status update succeeds (toast); Bulk selection checkboxes + Expédier/Arrivé bulk actions work; new-parcel-btn modal saves; Users view with new-user-btn creates user; Audit view lists entries. Operator login hides nav-users/nav-audit in sidebar (frontend RBAC gating).

issues: Post-login welcome toast still hardcoded 'Bienvenue Opérateur Terrain' in French regardless of language (pre-existing gap from iteration_9).

action_items: Minor (from iteration_9, still open): Translate 'Bienvenue {name}' toast via t() and translate 'Dépôt:'/'Arrivée:' labels in parcel table.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 553-line file with routes + seed + PDF generation + auth all in one; consider splitting into routers/services if it grows further, but not blocking now.
Public POST /api/parcels accepts arbitrary sender/receiver payload with NO rate limiting or captcha - fine for MVP but flag for prod.
PATCH /api/parcels/{id} does NOT record history when only weight/price change (only on status change) - this matches spec but may under-report changes for audit trail.
MongoDB _id correctly excluded via projection ({_id: 0}) everywhere - good.
JWT secret loaded from env (JWT_SECRET) - good, no hardcode.
Frontend axios interceptor to attach Bearer token works transparently (all authenticated calls in Backoffice succeed).
All interactive elements have data-testid - excellent testability.
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_ prefixed parcels and 1 TEST_ prefixed user via the tests (safe - prefixed for identification). No production/seed data modified beyond intended writes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Frontend all critical flows green: Landing, Send (both directions with intact Italy hub), Tracking (valid + invalid), Login, Backoffice Dashboard (12 KPIs + 3 charts), Parcels (search + detail drawer + status update via PATCH /status), Bulk actions, New Parcel modal, Users list + creation, Audit log, Operator RBAC (Users/Audit nav hidden). Only outstanding items are the 2 minor i18n gaps carried over from iteration_9 (welcome toast + 2 date labels).
